description: This file defines a singleton class 'KeychainStore' for securely storing, retrieving, and removing sensitive data such as access tokens and expiry information in the iOS Keychain.

classes.name: KeychainStore
classes.description: A singleton class providing an interface to securely store, retrieve, and delete sensitive data in the iOS Keychain.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Stores a string securely in the Keychain associated with a specific key.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a stored string from the Keychain for a given key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific key-value pair from the Keychain.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all stored entries related to the app's service from the Keychain.
